parameters.name: AccessMode
parameters.description:
The switchover policy for the address pool collection:

- AUTO: Automatic switchover

- DEFAULT: The primary address pool collection

- FAILOVER: The secondary address pool collection

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of certain response parameters. Default: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: StrategyId
parameters.description: The ID of the access policy. Call [DescribeDnsGtmAccessStrategies](~~2357191~~) to obtain the policy ID.
